ops.body:
- **T? [owner] A discarded memo's Undo goes after 5 s and has no Close** (2026-11-19)
  Area: walk-screen. Seen: `ws14-ready-undo-390.png` (the run's after pictures): "Voice memo discarded" with Undo, on the ready screen and on the walk, goes by itself after five seconds (`src/lib/useCaptures.ts`, `UNDO_MS`; `components/MomentBar.tsx` and `app/walk.tsx`, the discard pill) and offers no Close (the diff review's ux 1, medium, there before the run). Rests on: `.claude/rules/ui-patterns.md`, "Undo stays until it is used or dismissed (F3; M3: "Snackbars with actions shouldn't auto-dismiss"; NN/g faults a few-second Undo): the pill has Undo and Close" (decision 0113). It challenges decision 0008 ("undoable for 5 s"), which predates 0113.
  Recommended: the pill has Undo and Close and stays until it is used, closed, or replaced by the next capture; a memo set aside is let go then. /vision: aligned (Honour: a memo discarded by a slip is not lost to a timer; no word beyond Close).
  Precedent: Gmail's and Google Photos' Undo snackbars stay until acted on or replaced (from memory, not yet recorded); Apple Voice Memos keeps a deleted recording in Recently Deleted (from memory, not yet recorded); docs/research/adjacent-apps.md, "A capture that could not be saved", records none on a discard's Undo.
  Otherwise: keep 0008's 5 s.
Nov 19: the owner's yes, in person, 2026-11-19: "Two rows inside (Recommended)" (decision 0233). Waits for a build.

Nov 19: the owner's yes, in person, 2026-11-19: "Keep it whole (Recommended)": the full clip stored as a moment with its place and time, its length said, no trimming (decision 0233). Waits for a build.
Nov 19: the owner's yes, in person, 2026-11-19: "Camera stays (Recommended)", amending NR10 (decision 0233). Waits for a build.
Nov 19: the owner's yes, in person, 2026-11-19: "Done + map tap (Recommended)" (decision 0233). Waits for a build.

Nov 19: the owner's yes, in person, 2026-11-19: "Undo + Close, stays (Recommended)": Undo and Close, the pill staying until it is used, closed, or replaced by the next capture; it amends 0008 (decision 0233). Waits for a build.

argv: the owner, in person, 2026-11-19: "Keep the blue (Recommended)"; navigation keeps its own colour (decision 0233)
the owner, in person, 2026-11-19: "Keep it on (Recommended)"; the pause reminder stays on by default (decision 0233)

ops.body: - [loop] On the web, the browser's Back while Start is on its way ("Starting…") leaves the walk screen: the walk is written (`components/walk/useReady.tsx`, `start`) and records minimized, and its "Walk started · recording" notice is never said; `tend walk-screen 11` holds Android's Back only, since a `BackHandler` does nothing on the web and the browser's back can't be stopped cheaply (`.claude/rules/tabs-and-home.md`). The tab beneath could say the walk started (`/tend walk-screen`'s diff review, auditor 3, Nov 19, low)

- [loop] The drawer's motion row ends in a bare word, "Turn on", where the settings' other trailing actions are outlined buttons (the destination's Clear, Send a test notification): give it the same outlined pill (`app/walk.tsx`, `motion-on`, `styles.motionOn`; H4; `/tend walk-screen`'s diff review, ux 3, Nov 19, low)

- [loop] "Passing a place" says what passing is, not what follows from it (the walk's replay names the places passed, `docs/PRODUCT.md`): a line that says so would be new words, so it goes to `/vision` first (`components/ExploreSettings.tsx`, `passNote`; H2, H10; `/tend walk-screen`'s diff review, ux 4, Nov 19, low)

- [loop] The walk's spot card and a place's card lay their actions in a wrapping row, so at 390 four buttons take three lines and the × rides the last one (`ws15-spot-card-390`): a column of full-width buttons with the × in the title row would read in one pass (ui-patterns, **[app]** nothing wraps at 320; `/tend walk-screen`'s diff review, ux 5, Nov 19, low, opinion)

- [loop] No journey raises the dead-zone nudge (ten minutes walking far from every busy area), so its 44 pt Dismiss and its wrapped text below 360 (`tend walk-screen 14`, `audit 13`) are held by source tests only: a harness hook that makes the nudge due at once (beside `deadZoneDue`), and a 320 check with its picture, would hold them (`/tend walk-screen`'s diff review, auditor 2, Nov 19, low)

argv: the diff review's ux: the grip draws over the text on both hosts, the walk's drawer too
ops.body: - [loop] Pulled up, the bar's grip band is clear, so its handle draws over the settings' text as they scroll under it, on both hosts: the ready bar's settings and the walk's drawer (`components/walk/ReadyBar.tsx`, `grip`; picture `ws10-drawer-390-end`): give the band the bar's ground while up (`/tend walk-screen`'s review, ux 8, Nov 19, low)
Nov 19: the owner allowed, in person, a one-off non-loop run for the walk screen's compiler skips after `/tend walk-screen` lands; that run takes their lines out of `compiler.baseline.json`.

**Nov 19, `/tend walk-screen --deploy=main`, a whole, uncapped sweep** (opened from `1fcf0f0d`, rebuilt on `777d0617`; lenses 1-7 all run; the first of decision 0229's whole sweeps).
- Lenses: 1, the `ready` and `walk` journeys' pictures (ux-reviewer and steward); 2-4 read from the code and the specs; 5, the auditor, with `perf-walk` 4 min; 6, `check:vision --list` clean; 7, the area's `[loop]` items.
- Shipped: `tend walk-screen 10` the layers key heads itself, only over rows ("On the map" over nothing since the Places layer); `11` Back does nothing while Start is on its way, and waits for focus; `12` the walk's strip of numbers is named for a screen reader; `13` the Add to this moment offer steps aside while a place is armed; `14` small targets 44 pt themselves (no hitSlop on the web); `15` "What happened here", no count; `16` "Passing a place" in one sentence.
- The review (one round; the auditor and the ux-reviewer; accepted 5, deferred 4, to the owner 1, rejected 0): `audit 12` the strip's name says what it draws, word for word, ticking with it (a regression of 12); `audit 13` below 360 the dead-zone nudge's text has its own line (a regression of 14); `audit 14`, `15`, `16` journey checks (the viewer after What happened here, "On the map" with a layer on, the offer back after Cancel, "Turn on" measured).
- Not shipped: WalkScreen's React Compiler skips (auditor 2, medium): CM2 wants their lines out of `compiler.baseline.json`, which the loop may not edit. In "Open before the loop"; the owner allowed a one-off non-loop run after this lands.
- The owner's answers, in person (decision 0233): T42 "Two rows inside", T43 "Keep it whole", T44 "Camera stays", T45 "Done + map tap", T48 "Undo + Close, stays": yeses, each noted and waiting for a build; T46 "Keep the blue" and T47 "Keep it on": removed, today's behaviour stands.
- Filed besides: lows `[loop]` in "Navigate, ready", one in the map's section, one in "Vision gate"; two `[owner]` lows; five phone checks; the N11 mirror in "Open before the loop".
- The area stays `rough`: this sweep found mediums (section 8).
- Journeys on the final build: walk, ready, where, layers, launch.
